# Browse files and folders

<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Find files and folders in the selected workspace and control which folders are open in the Files sidebar section.

## Browse the folder tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/files.ts -->

1. Open the **Files** sidebar section in a workspace whose folder is a Git repository.
2. Find the file or folder in the tree; folders appear before files, and each group is listed alphabetically.
3. Click a folder row to fold or unfold that folder.

The tree shows files tracked by Git and new files. When the option to show ignored files is enabled, ignored folders also appear and cannot be unfolded.

## Refresh or fold the tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

Select **Refresh** to read the tree again, or select **Collapse all folders** to fold every folder.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

### The Files sidebar section says the workspace is not a Git repository
**Cause**: The selected workspace is not a Git repository.
**Solution**:
1. Select a workspace that is a Git repository.
2. Open the **Files** sidebar section.
**Check**: The folder tree appears.

# Change the Files list appearance

# Create a file or folder

<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Create an empty file or folder in the repository of the selected workspace.

## Choose where to create the item
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

Select a folder to create the item there, or select a file to create the item in that file's folder. With no row selected, the item goes in the repository root.

## Create the file or folder
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

1. Select **New file** or **New folder** in the Files sidebar section.
2. Enter a name without `/` and press **Enter**.

Press **Escape** or click outside the name box to cancel. The new row is selected after creation, and a new file opens in the large Git window.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

### The name box stays open after Enter
**Cause**: The name contains `/` or an item with that name already exists in the selected folder.
**Solution**:
1. Remove `/` from the name, or enter a name that is not already used in the selected folder.
2. Press **Enter**.
**Check**: The new row appears in the folder tree and is selected.

# Files sidebar section

<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: reference -->

Look up what the Files sidebar section displays and what its controls do.

## Folder tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/files.ts -->

The tree shows files tracked by Git and new files. When showing ignored files is enabled, ignored folders appear as closed folders that cannot be unfolded. Folders created with **New folder** also appear while Heidrun remains open, although Git does not list empty folders. Folders appear before files, and each group is listed alphabetically.

Changed files have a status letter at the right of their row.

## Header buttons
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

| Name | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **New file** | Starts creating an empty file in the selected folder, the folder of the selected file, or the repository root. |
| **New folder** | Starts creating an empty folder in the selected folder, the folder of the selected file, or the repository root. |
| **Refresh** | Reads the folder tree again. |
| **Collapse all folders** | Folds every folder. |
| **More options** | Opens the choices for indentation, row height, and indent guides. |

## More options
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

| Name | Choices |
| --- | --- |
| **Indentation** | **Small**, **Medium**, or **Large** |
| **Row height** | **Compact** or **Comfortable** |
| **Indent guides** | **Show** or **Hide** |

A check mark identifies the choice that is active in each group.

## Rows and selection
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

Clicking a file or folder selects its row. Only one row can be selected at a time in a workspace; click empty space in the Files sidebar section to clear that workspace's selection. Each workspace remembers its selected row.

## Tree updates
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/files.ts -->

The tree is read again when the selected repository changes, when the number of changed files changes, and when you select **Refresh**. **Collapse all folders** folds every folder; there is no control to unfold every folder.

## Open a file from the Files sidebar section
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

1. Select a workspace that is a Git repository.
2. Find the file in the **Files** sidebar section.
3. Click the file row to open it in the large Git window.

An unchanged file appears as a whole file, and **Diff** and **Side by side** are disabled.
